model.scope: Synthetic branch-equivalence only; no game execution, schedule, lifetime or backend validation.

limits: No all-writers, all-callers, concrete live-instance, backend voice-ID mapping, or guaranteed update scheduling proof.
Fresh package decompression is separately reproducible through retail-probe; --check verifies captured original stored bytes and exact loose payload identities.

findings: Independently reviewed constructor/resource-binding pseudocode and signed comparison ASM anchors against the original-file verifier.
Original objentry flags+72 bit0 skips the auxiliary resource assignment; absence of type34 in MDLX alone is explicitly not used as the proof.
Descriptor identity and virtual slot are based on the original row, factory case, stored descriptor, vtable and RTTI bytes.
Request setter is deferred; low priority can replace an idle request, equal priority replaces a pending/current request.
The no-op is conditional on the selected original row and absence of later or transitive writers. No instance identity or universal silence claim is made.
limits: Uses the pinned existing asset decoder for fresh archive decompression; its entire implementation is not independently re-proved.
No game, original native instructions, script VM, audio backend or live scheduler executed.
All-writers and transitive constructor closure remain open.
